mapper.sql: record_id, user_id, point_id, food_type, amount, quantity, remark, feed_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed_record (user_id, point_id, food_type, amount, quantity, remark, feed_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{pointId}, #{foodType}, #{amount}, #{quantity}, #{remark}, #{feedTime})
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.nickname, u.username, COUNT(*) AS count FROM feed_record f JOIN `user` u ON f.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.nickname, u.username ORDER BY count DESC, u.user_id
